name: Until Eleven
source:
Kat's life is not turning out the way she had planned. She's jobless, broke, and worst of all - her boyfriend of 2 years just dumped her unceremoniously.

Then something amazing happens. Kat discovers she has an alternate life on the other side of her mirror, a life that is everything she has always wanted. So when her alternate self offers to switch places for the day, Kat jumps at the chance.

Only life on the other side is not what it seemed. Unfortunately, getting back home is not as easy as she thought.

[From [url=https://rosearcanagames.itch.io/until-eleven]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
凯特的生活并没有按照她的计划发展。她失业、身无分文，最糟糕的是——交往两年的男友毫不客气地抛弃了她。

然后奇妙的事情发生了。凯特发现镜子的另一边有另一种生活，这是她一直想要的一切。因此，当她的另一个自我提出今天要换地方时，凯特抓住了这个机会。

只是另一边的生活并不像看上去的那样。不幸的是，回家并不像她想象的那么容易。

[来自[url=https://rosearcanagames.itch.io/until-eleven]Itch.io[/url]]
